items.description: +9 slots (one more row). Carry more before you turn back.
A single jump reaches farther, so depth is earned.
Worlds within range of any world you have visited show their resources.
Dedicated slots for fuel cells, plasma and antimatter, so fuel stops eating backpack space.
Biocomposite plating that lets the hull set down on toxic worlds.
Thermal alloy plating for volcanic and desert worlds.
Cryo composite plating for glacial worlds.
Rad-Shield alloy plating for irradiated worlds and hostile stars.
Void alloy shell for worlds where space itself is thin.
+15% firing speed for placed turrets. Does not spawn turrets.
Every stack in your backpack and warehouses holds more: the end-game answer to storage.
